console.title: Radix Console — Developer tools
console.description: Send tokens and NFTs, create resources, deploy packages, send raw manifests, configure metadata and convert Olympia addresses on the Radix Network.

console.heroDescription: The developer console for the Radix Network. Send tokens and NFTs, create fungible and non-fungible resources, deploy Scrypto packages, send raw transaction manifests, configure on-ledger metadata and convert Olympia addresses. Connect your wallet to start building.

sidebar.title: Radix Console
sidebar.subtitle: Build, deploy and manage assets on the Radix Network.

send-transaction.title: Send Transaction
send-transaction.description: Build a transfer of tokens and NFTs to one or several accounts with the wallet transaction builder, and inspect the generated manifest.

create-token.title: Create Token
create-token.description: Create a fungible or non-fungible resource with custom metadata, supply and behaviour, and deploy it to the Radix Network.

deploy-package.title: Deploy Package
deploy-package.description: Deploy a new blueprint package to the network by attaching your WASM and RPD files and submitting a transaction with your Radix Wallet.

transaction-manifest.title: Transaction Manifest
transaction-manifest.description: Write a raw transaction manifest and send it as a transaction request to your Radix Wallet.

configure-metadata.title: Configure Metadata
configure-metadata.description: Inspect and update the on-ledger metadata of accounts, resources, components and validators.

convert-olympia-address.title: Convert Olympia Address
convert-olympia-address.description: Convert an Olympia account or resource address into its Babylon equivalent.

common.connectDescription: This tool sends transactions through the Radix Wallet. Choose a network and connect your wallet to continue.
common.ownerRoleHint: Who is allowed to act as the owner of this entity.

errors.wallet_not_connected: Connect your wallet before sending the transaction.
errors.toolkit_not_initialized: The wallet toolkit could not be initialised for this network.
errors.timeout: The wallet request timed out. Please try again.
errors.rejected: The transaction was rejected or cancelled in the wallet.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while sending the transaction.

createToken.trackSupplyHint: Whether the engine should track the total supply
createToken.name: Name
createToken.lockHint: Lock this field so it can never be changed
createToken.authRolesHint: Fine-grained behaviour of the resource. The defaults create a simple token without minting or burning.
createToken.invalidDivisibility: Must be an integer between 0 and 18

optionHints.owner: Only the owner role defined above can perform this action.
optionHints.denyAll: Nobody can ever perform this action — it is permanently disabled.
optionHints.allowAll: Anyone can perform this action without restrictions.

roleHints.minter: Who can mint (create) new units of this token, increasing its supply.
roleHints.minter_updater: Who can change the minter rule later.
roleHints.burner: Who can burn (destroy) units of this token, reducing its supply.
roleHints.burner_updater: Who can change the burner rule later.
roleHints.freezer: Who can freeze vaults holding this token, blocking transfers from them.
roleHints.freezer_updater: Who can change the freezer rule later.
roleHints.recaller: Who can recall (pull back) tokens directly from other accounts’ vaults.
roleHints.recaller_updater: Who can change the recaller rule later.
roleHints.withdrawer: Who can withdraw this token from vaults. "Allow all" makes it freely transferable.
roleHints.withdrawer_updater: Who can change the withdrawer rule later.
roleHints.depositer: Who can deposit this token into vaults. Kept open so anyone can receive it.
roleHints.depositer_updater: Who can change the depositer rule later.
roleHints.metadata_setter: Who can edit the token metadata (name, symbol, icon, ...).
roleHints.metadata_setter_updater: Who can change the metadata setter rule later.
roleHints.metadata_locker: Who can permanently lock metadata fields so they can never change again.
roleHints.metadata_locker_updater: Who can change the metadata locker rule later.
roleHints.nft_data_setter: Who can modify the data stored inside each NFT after minting.
roleHints.nft_data_setter_updater: Who can change the NFT data setter rule later.

deployPackage.dropRpd: Drop the .rpd file here, or click to browse

manifest.label: Transaction manifest
manifest.note: Do not include reserved instructions like "lock_fee" — the wallet adds them itself according to user preferences and will reject manifests that contain them.
manifest.flowEmpty: Write a transaction manifest to generate its flow diagram.

flow.start: The Radix Wallet signs the transaction
flow.startHint: Your wallet adds the fee payment (lock_fee), shows you a preview and asks for your approval before anything runs.
flow.endHint: Every step is applied atomically: if any single step fails, the whole transaction is rejected and nothing changes.

withdraw.title: Withdrawal
withdraw.description: Takes {amount} of the resource out of the account vault and places it on the worktop, the temporary work surface of the transaction.

withdrawNfts.title: NFT withdrawal
withdrawNfts.description: Takes {count} non-fungible(s) out of the account vault and places them on the worktop.

take.title: Bucket from worktop
take.description: Picks up {amount} of the resource from the worktop into a named bucket, ready to be passed to the next call.

takeAll.title: Bucket from worktop
takeAll.description: Picks up the entire balance of the resource from the worktop into a named bucket.

takeNfts.title: NFT bucket from worktop
takeNfts.description: Picks up {count} specific non-fungible(s) from the worktop into a named bucket.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.description: Hands the bucket to the destination account. If the account refuses the deposit (e.g. third-party deposit rules), the whole transaction aborts safely.

depositBatch.title: Deposit everything
depositBatch.description: Deposits every resource still left on the worktop into the destination account, so nothing is lost.

proof.title: Badge proof
proof.description: Presents a proof of holding the badge — without moving it — to authorise the protected actions that follow.

setMetadata.title: Set metadata
setMetadata.description: Writes the on-ledger metadata field "{key}" of the entity. Wallets and explorers read these fields to display the entity.

removeMetadata.title: Remove metadata
removeMetadata.description: Deletes the on-ledger metadata field "{key}" from the entity.

createFungible.title: New fungible resource
createFungible.description: Creates a brand-new fungible resource with an initial supply of {supply} and leaves it on the worktop to be deposited.

createNonFungible.title: New non-fungible resource
createNonFungible.description: Creates a brand-new non-fungible resource, minting its initial NFTs onto the worktop.

publish.title: Publish package
publish.description: Uploads a compiled Scrypto package (WASM + definition) to the network so its blueprints can be instantiated.

burn.title: Burn
burn.description: Permanently destroys the resource in the bucket. This cannot be undone.

call.title: Method call
call.description: Invokes the on-ledger method "{method}" of the component, which executes its Scrypto logic.

callFunction.title: Function call
callFunction.description: Invokes the function "{func}" of the blueprint "{blueprint}", typically instantiating a new component.

metadata.loadError: Could not load the entity. Check the address and the selected network.
metadata.proofsHint: If the entity only allows its owner to update metadata, present the owner badge from one of your accounts.
metadata.noChanges: There are no changes to send
